item.content:encoded:
Career

Welcome to Orange Offices Careers, where your passion for innovation, collaboration, and professional growth can thrive. Orange Offices by AIHP is more than just a workspace provider—we are a community that fosters success, creativity, and career development.

If you’re looking for a rewarding career in a dynamic and inspiring workplace, Orange Offices might just be the perfect fit for you!

Why Work at Orange Offices?

A Great Work Environment

We believe that great work comes from happy employees. Here at Orange Offices, we grow a caring and stimulating culture of teamwork, communication, and creativity that drives results.

Endless Coffee & Refreshments

Great coffee is the source of many innovative ideas! Receive unlimited coffee, tea, and snacks to top up your levels all day long.

Competitive Salary & Benefits

Your dedication is worth the best of the best remuneration. We provide salaries that are at par with industry standards, performance-based bonuses, and career-strengthening benefits to support and retain our best performers.

Career Growth & Development

We care about your future. Orange Offices provides mentorship programs, professional development, and leadership positions to support your growth and progression in your profession.

Collaborative & Inclusive Culture

We honor diversity, collaboration, and innovation. Each member of our team is instrumental in creating our industry-leading solutions, and your voice will always be heard and respected.

Discover Our Job Opportunities

Are you ready to join Orange Offices mission to transform workspaces in Gurgaon? We seek enthusiastic professionals across different fields, including:

Discover your next career opportunity and apply now!
Operations & Facility Management Leasing & Business Development Marketing & Branding Design & Architecture Customer Support & Client Relations

Didn't find a role that suits your skills? No worries! Share your resume with us at careers@orangeoffices.in, and we'll consider you for future positions.

Become a part of Orange Offices – Where Careers and Workspaces Evolve Together

At Orange Offices, we don't simply provide employment—we forge careers that thrive in a space designed for excellence and teamwork. If you're seeking an organization where your suggestions count, let's hear from you!

Join us today and be part of something remarkable!

item.title: Custom Lead form CT
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
<style>
        .form-container {
            background: #fff;
            padding: 20px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            width: 300px;
        }
        input, textarea, .iti input[type=tel] {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            border: 1px solid var(--e-global-color-cfa1f76) !important ;
            border-radius: 15px !important;
            background: #fff !important;
        }
        button {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;
            margin-top: 10px;
            background: #007bff;
            color: #fff;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 18px;
        }
        button:hover {
            background: #0056b3;
        }
        label {
            display: none;
        }
        @media (min-width: 1100px) {
            .name-container {
                display: flex;
                gap: 10px;
            }
            .name-container input {
                width: 50%;
            }
            .form-container {
                width: 400px;
            }
        }
    </style>
<!-- Include CleverTap SDK -->
<form id="leadCaptureForm">
        <input type="text" id="firstName" name="firstName" placeholder="First Name" required>
        <input type="text" id="lastName" name="lastName" placeholder="Last Name" required>
    <input type="email" id="email" name="email" placeholder="Email Address" required>
    <input type="tel" id="phone" name="phone" placeholder="Phone No." required>
    <input type="text" id="city" name="city" placeholder="City" required>
    <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="4" placeholder="Your Message"></textarea>
    <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>				
		[wpcode id="3846"][wpcode id="3845"]

item.content:encoded:
Your Trusted Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR

Orange Offices is your trusted partner in designing and building custom office spaces that inspire creativity, foster collaboration and reflect your unique vision.

Get in Touch About
Who we are

At Orange Offices, we believe that a thoughtfully designed workspace is essential for business success. As leading Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR, we provide end-to-end design solutions tailored to your company’s culture, objectives, and operational requirements.

Our Mission

To deliver innovative, functional and eco-conscious office designs tailored to our clients’ unique needs, ensuring world-class quality, exceptional customer service and fast delivery within 45 days. Through creativity, sustainability and collaboration, we aim to transform workspaces into dynamic hubs of productivity and innovation.

Our Vision

To become the leading provider of innovative, sustainable and custom-designed office spaces that empower businesses to thrive. At Orange Offices, we envision a world where every workspace is a dynamic hub for creativity, collaboration and productivity.

Our Core Values

Creativity

Pushing boundaries to craft unique, forward-thinking designs.

Sustainability

Prioritizing eco-friendly practices and materials in every project.

Quality

Delivering excellence in every detail, from furniture to finishes.

Timeliness

Respecting your time with on-schedule project completion.

Our Journey

Founded as an extension of AIHP’s expertise in managed office spaces, Orange Offices was launched to cater to businesses seeking innovative and custom-designed work environments across Delhi NCR. Over the years, we’ve helped companies of all sizes transform their offices into spaces that inspire creativity, foster collaboration and drive growth.

 

Clients 0 + Sq. Ft Fitted Out 0 L+ On-time Delivery 0 % Years Experience 0 +

What Sets Us Apart?

Custom Designs, Tailored to You

Every office we design is a unique reflection of your brand, culture and business needs.

Sustainable and Eco-Conscious

We integrate energy-efficient systems, eco-friendly materials and biophilic elements to create healthier work environments.

Expert Team

Our in-house team of architects and designers brings global expertise and creative vision to every project.

Fast Delivery

We understand the importance of time in business, which is why we guarantee fully operational offices in just 45 days.

End-to-End Solutions

From concept development to project management and final delivery, we handle everything so you can focus on growing your business.

Who We Serve

We work with a diverse range of clients, including:

Startups and Entrepreneurs

Building vibrant and functional spaces that fuel innovation.

Corporate Offices

Designing sleek, professional environments that reflect business goals

Co-Working Spaces

Creating adaptable layouts that cater to shared workspace needs.

Small Businesses

Delivering smart designs that make the most of every square foot.

Want to see our latest projects? Connect with us on social media for updates, insights, and exciting new designs!

📸 Instagram: Orange Offices
💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices
🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Why us

Why Choose Orange Offices?

✔ Experts in Modern Office Interiors – Designing smart, collaborative, and inspiring workspaces with the expertise of Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR.

✔ Sustainable & Eco-Friendly Designs – Utilizing LEED-certified materials for greener offices designed by Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR.

✔ Comprehensive Solutions – Managing everything from concept to execution with the proficiency of Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR.

✔ Scalable & Flexible Workspaces – Adaptive designs that grow with your business, implemented by Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR.

✔ Tailored Design Concepts – Bespoke office solutions crafted by Office Interior Experts in Delhi NCR.

Trusted By 600+ World-Class Brands And Organizations

Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon

Get in touch with our expert team for Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon. Let’s Design Your Ideal Workspace

Let’s Connect and Bring Your Office Vision to Life

Planning to design or renovate your office? At Orange Offices, we offer expert Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon, helping businesses craft functional, stylish, and productivity-enhancing workspaces. A well-designed office not only enhances workflow efficiency but also reflects a company’s brand identity and culture. Our Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon ensures that every element of your office is optimized for comfort, collaboration, and growth.

Headquarter

item.title: Journal
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
Office Interior Design Journal & Insights – Expert Perspectives & Trends

The Office Interior Design Journal & Insights by Orange Offices brings you in-depth insights, industry trends, and expert perspectives on modern office spaces and the future of workplace design.

Natural Materials Sustainability Less Is More Pops of Personality Light as Design Harmony in Contrast

Timeless Design Principles for Inspiring Workspaces

Discover the perfect balance of simplicity, sustainability and creativity. These principles breathe life into workspaces, transforming them into havens of productivity and inspiration

Natural Materials

At Orange Offices, we believe in the beauty and authenticity of natural materials. From rich woods to stone textures, these elements ground workspaces in nature, creating environments that feel warm, organic and timeless. Using sustainable materials not only enhances the aesthetic appeal of the office but also promotes a deeper connection between people and the spaces they inhabit.

Sustainability

Sustainability is at the core of our design philosophy. We are committed to using eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions in every project. By prioritizing green design, we ensure that our spaces support both the environment and the well-being of those who work in them. This approach reflects our responsibility to create workplaces that are as mindful of the planet as they are of the people who use them.

Less Is More

We embrace minimalism in design because it allows the essence of a space to shine. By reducing clutter and focusing on the essentials, we create work environments that foster clarity and calm. A clean, simple design enables creativity to flow without distractions, providing employees with the mental space they need to innovate and thrive.

Pops of Personality

Every workspace has a unique story to tell. With carefully selected art, vibrant colors and statement pieces, we inject personality into every design. These touches make the space feel alive, dynamic and reflective of the company’s identity. It’s the little details that transform a functional space into an inspiring one.

Light as Design

Lighting is more than just a tool; it’s a key design element that shapes the mood and functionality of a workspace. At Orange Offices, we use both natural and artificial lighting to create a harmonious atmosphere. Whether it’s the soft glow of natural light streaming through windows or strategically placed fixtures, light enhances the aesthetic and performance of a space.

Harmony in Contrast

At Orange Offices, we believe in the power of contrast to bring a design to life. By blending different textures, colors and materials, we create spaces that are visually engaging and full of energy. The juxtaposition of soft and bold, dark and light, modern and traditional creates a sense of balance that elevates the overall design, making it both dynamic and cohesive.

item.content:encoded:
Premium Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon

Transform your workspace with bespoke office design and interiors. Orange Offices creates inspiring environments for businesses across Delhi NCR

What We Do

At Orange Offices, we specialize in delivering top-notch Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon that redefine workspaces with elegance, functionality, and innovation. Our approach ensures that every office interior is thoughtfully designed to reflect brand identity while optimizing efficiency and productivity. Whether you're a startup, an established corporation, or a co-working space provider, we offer tailored solutions to meet diverse workspace requirements.

Why Choose Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon?

A well-designed office fosters a positive work environment, enhances productivity, and leaves a lasting impression on employees and clients. At Orange Offices, we bring expertise, creativity, and technical proficiency to design workspaces that are both stylish and practical. Here’s why businesses trust us:

✔ Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon – We create customized office spaces that align with your business goals and aesthetics.
✔ Ergonomic & Employee-Friendly Designs – Our office interiors support comfort, reducing strain and improving well-being.
✔ Smart Space Utilization – We maximize space efficiency while ensuring smooth workflow and movement.
✔ Sustainable & Green Designs – Our designs incorporate eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient technologies.
✔ Seamless Execution & Timely Delivery – With meticulous planning, we complete projects on time without compromising quality.

Our Comprehensive Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon

1. Turnkey Office Interior Solutions

Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon cover everything from conceptualization to execution. We manage all aspects of design, procurement, and installation, ensuring a hassle-free process for our clients. Whether you’re setting up a new office or revamping an existing space, our turnkey solutions provide a seamless transformation.

2. Customized Office Interiors

We believe that no two businesses are the same, which is why we offer tailored Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon that reflect your brand personality. Our team collaborates with you to understand your vision and brings it to life with high-quality materials, innovative layouts, and modern aesthetics.

3. Sustainable & Smart Workspaces

Sustainability is at the core of our design philosophy. We incorporate energy-efficient lighting, eco-friendly materials, and biophilic design elements to create green workspaces that promote employee well-being. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon also integrate automation and IoT technology to enhance efficiency.

4. Office Renovation & Remodeling

If your office feels outdated or lacks functionality, our renovation services can breathe new life into your space. We upgrade office layouts, improve lighting, enhance acoustics, and introduce contemporary design elements to create a vibrant and dynamic work environment. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon ensure that your workspace stays modern and functional.

5. Modular Office Interiors

Flexibility is key in modern office design. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon provide modular interiors that allow businesses to adapt their workspace as they grow. From movable partitions to adjustable desks, we provide solutions that can evolve with your organization’s needs.

6. Smart Office Automation

We integrate technology to create smart office environments. Automated lighting, climate control, and AI-driven workspaces enhance efficiency and employee comfort. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon include:

✔ Smart meeting rooms with AI-driven scheduling.
✔ Automated lighting and HVAC systems.
✔ IoT-enabled workspaces for seamless collaboration.

Transforming Workspaces with Expertise & Creativity

At Orange Offices, we are committed to designing workspaces that boost creativity, efficiency, and collaboration. Whether you prefer a sleek, minimalist design or a lively, energetic setup, our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon will craft an office that aligns with your business culture and vision. We have successfully transformed office spaces across various industries, including IT, finance, healthcare, and media.

💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices
🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Why Choose Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon?

A well-designed office fosters a positive work environment, enhances productivity, and leaves a lasting impression on employees and clients. At Orange Offices, we bring expertise, creativity, and technical proficiency to design workspaces that are both stylish and practical. Here’s why businesses trust us:

✔ Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon – We create customized office spaces that align with your business goals and aesthetics.
✔ Ergonomic & Employee-Friendly Designs – Our office interiors support comfort, reducing strain and improving well-being.
✔ Smart Space Utilization – We maximize space efficiency while ensuring smooth workflow and movement.
✔ Sustainable & Green Designs – Our designs incorporate eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient technologies.
✔ Seamless Execution & Timely Delivery – With meticulous planning, we complete projects on time without compromising quality.

Our Comprehensive Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon

1. Turnkey Office Interior Solutions

Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon cover everything from conceptualization to execution. We manage all aspects of design, procurement, and installation, ensuring a hassle-free process for our clients. Whether you're setting up a new office or revamping an existing space, our turnkey solutions provide a seamless transformation.

2. Customized Office Interiors

We believe that no two businesses are the same, which is why we offer tailored Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon that reflect your brand personality. Our team collaborates with you to understand your vision and brings it to life with high-quality materials, innovative layouts, and modern aesthetics.

3. Sustainable & Smart Workspaces

Sustainability is at the core of our design philosophy. We incorporate energy-efficient lighting, eco-friendly materials, and biophilic design elements to create green workspaces that promote employee well-being. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon also integrate automation and IoT technology to enhance efficiency.

4. Office Renovation & Remodeling

If your office feels outdated or lacks functionality, our renovation services can breathe new life into your space. We upgrade office layouts, improve lighting, enhance acoustics, and introduce contemporary design elements to create a vibrant and dynamic work environment. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon ensure that your workspace stays modern and functional.

5. Modular Office Interiors

Flexibility is key in modern office design. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon provide modular interiors that allow businesses to adapt their workspace as they grow. From movable partitions to adjustable desks, we provide solutions that can evolve with your organization’s needs.

6. Smart Office Automation

We integrate technology to create smart office environments. Automated lighting, climate control, and AI-driven workspaces enhance efficiency and employee comfort. Our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon include:

✔ Smart meeting rooms with AI-driven scheduling.
✔ Automated lighting and HVAC systems.
✔ IoT-enabled workspaces for seamless collaboration.

Transforming Workspaces with Expertise & Creativity

At Orange Offices, we are committed to designing workspaces that boost creativity, efficiency, and collaboration. Whether you prefer a sleek, minimalist design or a lively, energetic setup, our Office Interior Design Services in Gurgaon will craft an office that aligns with your business culture and vision. We have successfully transformed office spaces across various industries, including IT, finance, healthcare, and media.

item.title: ANAND RATHI WEALTH
item.dc:creator: Saarthak
item.content:encoded:
Project info

Client
Anand Rathi Wealth
Project Year
2024
Location
M3M IFC, Gurgaon
SIZE
16257.61 8SQft

Anand Rathi Wealth: The Journey to a Transformative Workspace

Anand Rathi, a trusted name in India’s financial services since 1994, needed a workspace that matched its growth and aspirations. With a presence in 54 cities, their old office no longer supported their expanding team or evolving needs for collaboration and creativity. We partnered with Anand Rathi to design a modern, dynamic office that reflects their professionalism and values. The result is a functional and inspiring space that fosters innovation, enhances productivity and strengthens client relationships, empowering their continued growth in the financial industry.

Finding the Perfect Fit

Anand Rathi’s search for a new office was driven by the need for a space that reflected their growth and values. They needed a modern, collaborative environment that would inspire both their team and clients. Orange Offices understood our vision from the start," says a representative from Anand Rathi. "They created a space that truly feels like ours—elegant, functional and aligned with our goals. The new office is a perfect blend of design and practicality, fostering innovation while showcasing the firm’s commitment to excellence.

Bringing the Vision to Life

Anand Rathi’s new office was carefully designed to support their evolving needs. The layout blends flexibility and functionality, with a mix of collaborative spaces, private areas and modern amenities, making it an ideal environment for both team productivity and client meetings. The final result is a space that enhances the firm’s operations while inspiring creativity. Thoughtfully incorporated natural light and contemporary design elements have created an atmosphere that promotes focus, collaboration and a sense of pride among the team, positioning the office for future growth and success.
At Orange Offices, we take pride in transforming spaces that inspire and empower. For Anand Rathi, this office is a testament to the perfect blend of design, functionality and vision.

Encouraging Transparency and Flexibility

https://youtu.be/SZg3GQYhwZY AIHP has been a reliable partner for the last seven years. During our time at Star Tower, they not only fulfilled our specific office requirements but also guided us with valuable improvements based on their expertise. Our decision to move to the 21st floor of IFC M3M was another great experience—AIHP created an incredible office environment that aligns perfectly with our wealth management services. The space consistently impresses our high-net-worth clients, showcasing what a premier wealth management outfit should look like. Mukesh Kumawat Executive Director at Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd.

At Orange Offices, we take pride in transforming spaces that inspire and empower. For Anand Rathi, this office is a testament to the perfect blend of design, functionality and vision.

Encouraging Transparency and Flexibility

AIHP has been a reliable partner for the last seven years. During our time at Star Tower, they not only fulfilled our specific office requirements but also guided us with valuable improvements based on their expertise. Our decision to move to the 21st floor of IFC M3M was another great experience—AIHP created an incredible office environment that aligns perfectly with our wealth management services. The space consistently impresses our high-net-worth clients, showcasing what a premier wealth management outfit should look like.
Mukesh Kumawat
Executive Director at Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd.

item.title: ARCELOR MITTAL
item.dc:creator: Saarthak
item.content:encoded:
Project info

Client
Arcelor Mittal
Project Year
2023
Location
AIHP Milestone
Seats
30

The Journey to Arcelor Mittal’s New Workspace

ArcelorMittal, a global leader in steel and mining, has always been driven by a clear purpose: "Smarter steels for people and planet." Their commitment to innovation and sustainability has made them a key player in shaping the future of industries worldwide, from electric vehicles to renewable energy infrastructure. To match their forward-thinking approach, ArcelorMittal turned to Orange Offices for the design of a workspace that reflects their values. The new office blends modern design with functionality, offering dynamic and sustainable spaces that encourage collaboration and innovation. The result is a workplace that not only supports their evolving needs but also embodies their vision of a smarter, more sustainable future.

Design Brief and Development

ArcelorMittal approached us with a vision for their new workspace that needed to reflect their commitment to innovation and sustainability. We worked closely with their team to refine the concept, focusing on maximizing space efficiency while staying true to their brand. Through collaboration and attention to detail, from furniture selection to finishes, we created an environment that perfectly aligns with ArcelorMittal’s values and operational needs, fostering both creativity and productivity.

Reflecting Brand and Location

For ArcelorMittal’s new workspace, the design draws inspiration from the company’s commitment to sustainability and innovation. The space seamlessly integrates elements that reflect their global presence and forward-thinking approach. The use of sustainable materials, such as recycled fabrics and eco-friendly finishes, aligns with ArcelorMittal’s values of reducing environmental impact while enhancing functionality. The design also connects to the local character of the Gurgaon area, blending modern aesthetics with a strong sense of purpose. Located at AIHP Milestone, 448-451, Udhyog Vihar Phase-5, Gurgaon, the office embodies both the company’s global identity and its vision for a sustainable future. At AIHP, excellence is not just a goal it's the standard. Every aspect exceeds expectations, from their state-of-the-art offices to impeccable services and amenities. Choosing AIHP as our location was an easy decision. Their tailored designs perfectly suit our needs and their flexibility in creating space is unparalleled. World-class quality at every turn. Simply exceptional. Sudhir Sharma Regional Head, Arcelor Mittal Nippon Steel

Choosing AIHP as our location was an easy decision. Their tailored designs perfectly suit our needs and their flexibility in creating space is unparalleled. World-class quality at every turn. Simply exceptional.
Sudhir Sharma

Project info

Client
Dentsu
Project Year
2021
Location
AIHP Horizon
Seats
609

Dentsu: Fusing Legacy and Innovation Through Office Design

Dentsu, a global marketing leader, partnered with Orange Offices to transform their workspace at AIHP Horizon, Gurgaon, into a cutting-edge, collaborative environment that reflects their innovative spirit and rich legacy. The new design celebrates Dentsu’s forward-thinking ethos while embracing local character, creating a workspace that inspires creativity and fosters collaboration. This thoughtfully crafted office serves as a true hub for transformation, bringing dynamic teams together to drive innovation in the world of marketing.

Creating Balance

Bringing together multiple teams and functions within a single cohesive workspace was key to Dentsu’s vision. The challenge lay in designing zones that fostered collaboration while maintaining each team’s unique needs. By optimizing the layout and creating interconnected spaces, the design encourages seamless movement and interaction, ensuring that both staff and clients experience an environment that’s as unified as it is dynamic.

Tailored for Creativity and Collaboration

Dentsu's new office spans two thoughtfully designed floors, each color-coded to foster creativity and inspire collaboration. The vibrant color combinations align with Dentsu's dynamic brand identity while creating a visually stimulating environment. Every detail, from the layout to the furnishings, has been meticulously planned to support productivity and seamless teamwork. The design includes diverse work settings, meeting spaces and breakout areas, all carefully crafted to reflect Dentsu's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence.

FarMart: Pioneering Transformation Through Office Design

FarMart has evolved through continuous innovation, adapting to create meaningful solutions and standing at the forefront of the Good Food Economy. To reflect this journey, FarMart partnered with Orange Offices to design a workspace at AIHP Cyber Greens, Gurgaon, that embodies their commitment to sustainability, technology and empowerment. The office design seamlessly integrates elements of innovation and sustainability, creating a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and drives FarMart’s mission to empower communities and promote sustainable practices.

A Blank Canvas

When FarMart set out to redefine their workspace, the vision was clear: a versatile environment that would reflect their commitment to sustainability and innovation. Collaborating from the early stages, we developed a detailed proposal that aligned perfectly with their goals, creating a space that supports growth while reinforcing their brand identity. With a design approach that embraced simplicity, the workspace was treated as a blank canvas—concrete floors, clean lines and neutral finishes allowing FarMart to incorporate their unique ethos. The result is a dynamic, adaptable space where purpose meets creativity and innovation thrives.

Sustainability in Office Design

Sustainability in office design goes beyond aesthetics—it’s about creating spaces that minimize environmental impact while promoting well-being and productivity. Modern sustainable offices are designed with energy-efficient systems, eco-friendly materials and innovative layouts that prioritize natural light, ventilation and resource conservation. Key elements include the use of recycled or renewable materials, energy-efficient lighting and HVAC systems and biophilic design principles that integrate greenery to enhance indoor air quality and connect employees with nature. Water-saving fixtures, waste reduction initiatives and layouts that encourage collaboration while reducing energy use are also central to sustainable office design.

Wishlink: Inspiring Innovation Through Office Design

Wishlink, with its mission to transform shopping through creator-driven content, partnered with Orange Offices to design a workspace at AIHP Executive Center, Gurgaon, that reflects their innovative spirit. The office creates a dynamic, collaborative environment where creativity thrives, empowering their team to support millions of users and creators every month. This thoughtfully designed space fosters collaboration and innovation, helping Wishlink continue its journey of growth and success in reshaping the digital shopping experience.

Designing for Flexibility and Creativity at Wishlink

The office we created for Wishlink blends vibrant aesthetics with functional design. The space features an open-plan layout complemented by breakout areas that inspire collaboration and creativity. With 312 seats, the office is designed to accommodate both individual work and team interactions. Bold, colorful themes and dynamic wall art bring energy to the environment, while the heart of the office is dedicated to flexible meeting rooms. These rooms, equipped with folding walls, can easily transform into larger spaces, fostering versatility and adapting to the evolving needs of the team.

Balancing Style and Function

Wishlink’s office design preserves a dynamic balance between modern functionality and creative flair. The space integrates vibrant colors, bold wall art and modern furniture, contrasting with subtle industrial touches that give the office a unique character. The open-plan layout fosters collaboration, while flexible meeting areas and breakout spaces encourage spontaneous creativity. Designed to reflect Wishlink’s innovative approach, the office seamlessly blends style with practicality, offering a workspace that adapts to both individual focus and team collaboration.

MOZAIQ: Revolutionizing Mortgage Automation Through Office Design

MOZAIQ, a leader in intelligent mortgage automation, partnered with Orange Offices to create a cutting-edge workspace at AIHP Palms, Gurgaon. The office design reflects MOZAIQ’s innovative spirit, combining sleek, modern aesthetics with functionality to support agility, efficiency and seamless technology integration. With dedicated areas for focused work, collaboration and client meetings, the space fosters a dynamic and flexible environment that encourages productivity and growth. This thoughtfully crafted workspace enables MOZAIQ’s teams to push the boundaries of mortgage automation, driving innovation and leadership in their field. The design of MOZAIQ’s office in Udyog Vihar Phase 4, Gurgaon, seamlessly integrates modern aesthetics with the company’s commitment to innovation in healthcare. With sleek lines, a calming color palette and sustainable materials, the space fosters an atmosphere of trust and professionalism. The thoughtful design highlights MOZAIQ's mission to improve patient care, offering an environment conducive to collaboration and efficiency. By incorporating energy-efficient features and eco-friendly elements, the office not only reflects the company’s values but also ensures a workspace that supports both productivity and well-being.

Collaboration, Connectivity and Culture

The design of MOZAIQ’s office in Udyog Vihar Phase 4, Gurgaon, revolves around promoting collaboration and enhancing connectivity across teams. The space features a multifunctional hub with 301 seats, providing flexible seating arrangements, am ple power outlets and an open layout for both team collaborations and informal meetings. This central area fosters interaction, teamwork and a strong sense of community. Additionally, the office includes a wellness room and a fully equipped pantry to prioritize employee well-being. The design strikes a balance between functionality and comfort, supporting MOZAIQ’s mission of seamless healthcare coordination and fostering a positive workplace culture.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
• Home

How we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit our website or engage with our services. By using our website – orangeoffices.in, you consent to the practices described in this policy.

Information We Collect

  • Information You Provide
    • Personal details, such as your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you voluntarily provide when filling out forms or contacting us.

  • Automatically Collected Data
    • When you use our website, we use tools like Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to collect information about your visit. This may include:
      • Your IP address
      • Browser type and version
      • Device type (desktop, tablet, or mobile)
      • Geographic location (country, city)
      • Pages viewed and time spent on the site
      • Referring and exit pages
      • Clicks, scrolls, and other interaction data
      • Heatmaps and session recordings (via Microsoft Clarity)

How We Use Your Information

  • To analyse website traffic and user behaviour.
  • To improve website design, functionality, and content.
  • To respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
  • To comply with legal obligations.
  • To personalize your experience and provide relevant content.

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for their marketing purposes.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to collect data. Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us understand how you interact with our site. You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings.

Cookies We Use

  • Analytics cookies (Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity): Track user behaviour and website performance.
  • Functional cookies: Enhance website functionality and user experience.

Data Security

item.title: Bespoke Office Interior Design
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon – A Workspace That Reflects Your Brand

Orange Offices specializes in creating personalized office interiors that combine functionality and aesthetics, helping businesses in Delhi NCR bring their vision to life.

Get a Free Consultation

Bespoke Office Interior Design

At Orange Offices, we recognize that every business has its own identity. That’s why we specialize in Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon, creating workspaces that enhance brand identity, employee well-being, and operational efficiency. Our Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon services help businesses maximize their potential while providing employees with a space they enjoy working in.

Key Features of Our Bespoke Office Interiors:

✔ Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon – Unique designs that align with your company’s vision.
✔ Optimized Space Utilization – Smart layouts that maximize functionality.
✔ High-Quality Materials & Finishes – Premium craftsmanship for a polished, professional look.
✔ Hybrid & Collaborative Workspaces – Designed for flexibility and modern work environments.
✔ Personalized Branding – Interiors that reflect corporate culture and vision.
✔ Sustainable & Smart Workspaces – Eco-friendly materials and energy-efficient solutions.
✔ Modular & Scalable Designs – Adaptable layouts that grow with your business.
✔ Ergonomic & Employee-Friendly Designs – Prioritizing comfort and productivity.
✔ Turnkey Solutions – End-to-end Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon services from concept to completion.
✔ Smart Office Automation – Enhancing workspaces with AI-driven solutions.

Our team focuses on providing a seamless experience from the initial consultation to the final handover. We incorporate modern office design trends such as glass partitions, sustainable furniture, and acoustic-friendly designs to enhance your workspace. With our expertise in Custom Office Interior Design in Gurgaon, we ensure that every workspace is an innovative, functional, and inspiring environment.

Want to see our latest projects? Connect with us on social media: 📸 Instagram: Orange Offices 💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices 🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Read More Read Less
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Why Choose Bespoke Office Interior Design?

Reflect Your Brand Identity

Custom office interiors boost brand image and impress clients.

Maximize Productivity

Ergonomically designed spaces improve workflow and employee well-being.

Optimize Space Utilization

Smart layouts ensure every inch of your office is used effectively.

Our Approach to Bespoke Design

  • Understanding Your Vision
    We start by learning about your business, goals and preferences to ensure the design reflects your unique needs.

  • Concept Development
    Our team creates detailed concepts, including layouts, office space design ideas and material options.

  • Visualization
    With 3D renders and virtual walkthroughs, you can see exactly how your office will look before we begin execution.

  • Execution and Delivery
    From office reception design to office table design, we manage every detail and deliver your space within 45 days.

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Features of Our Bespoke Designs

  • Customized Furniture Solutions: Tailored office furniture designs that fit your space and style.

  • Creative Office Interiors: Unique layouts and design elements that make your office stand out.

  • Integrated Branding: Subtle yet impactful incorporation of your brand colors and logo into the design.

  • Smart Layouts: Optimize workflow and collaboration with innovative office space layouts.

Who Benefits from Bespoke Office Designs?

Startups

Quickly scale up as your team grows with minimal disruptions.

Hybrid Work Models

Adapt your space for a mix of in-office and remote work setups.

Small Businesses

Optimize smaller spaces with creative small office workstations

Co-Working Spaces

Offer flexible configurations to suit tenant preferences and maximize occupancy.

Project
Featured Projects

Crafting Office Designs That Inspire Productivity

Arcelor Mittal - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Crafted a vibrant, modern workspace with innovative workstations and dynamic collaborative areas, reflecting a forward-thinking vision.

Fresenius Kabi - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Created a purposeful, innovative workspace with adaptable zones to inspire collaboration and enhance efficiency.

Explore more of our projects to see how we’ve transformed spaces for businesses like yours.

Discover more

FAQs About Bespoke Office Design

1. How long does it take to complete a bespoke office design?

We deliver custom-designed offices within 30 days, ensuring minimal disruption to your operations.

2. Can you design offices for small spaces?

Absolutely. We specialize in modern office design ideas for small spaces that maximize utility and aesthetics.

3. What does bespoke office design include?

Our services include layout planning, furniture design, branding integration and complete project management.

Looking for custom office interior design in Gurgaon? Let’s create your ideal workspace today!

Ready to transform your workspace? Partner with Orange Offices for a tailor-made office interior design experience that prioritizes your vision and business goals.

Contact Our Design Team Today

item.title: Flexible Modular Office Design
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
Adaptable Modular Office Design in Gurgaon

Orange Offices delivers scalable, flexible modular office designs tailored to meet the evolving needs of businesses across Delhi NCR.

Get In Touch About

Flexible Modular Office Design

At Orange Offices, we understand that businesses need adaptable, scalable, and efficient workspaces. That’s why we offer modular office design in Gurgaon, providing customized solutions that maximize space, productivity, and flexibility.

Our modular office interiors ensure that your office evolves with your business, allowing quick reconfigurations while maintaining a modern and professional look.

Key Features of Our Modular Office Design in Gurgaon

✔ Customizable & Scalable Layouts – Adaptable designs that grow with your business.
✔ Smart Space Utilization – Optimized office layouts for maximum efficiency.
✔ High-Quality Materials & Finishes – Sleek, professional, and durable designs.
✔ Hybrid & Collaborative Workspaces – Designed for both teamwork and private focus.
✔ Sustainable & Smart Workspaces – Eco-friendly solutions for a greener office.
✔ Turnkey Modular Office Solutions – From design to execution, we handle everything.
✔ Rapid Implementation – Quick setup with minimal business disruption.
✔ Smart Technology Integration – Automation and IoT solutions for a modern workspace.

Our modular office design in Gurgaon transforms traditional office layouts into flexible, future-ready spaces.

🔹 Want to see our latest projects? Connect with us on social media:
📸 Instagram: Orange Offices
💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices
🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Read More Read Less
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Why Choose Modular Office Design?

Adaptability

Reconfigure office layouts for team growth and hybrid setups.

Cost-Effective

Modular designs save costs by allowing you to update or expand without major renovations.

Enhanced Collaboration

Open layouts and modular furniture encourage teamwork and creativity.

Features of Modular Office Designs

1. Scalable Layouts
  • Design spaces that can grow or shrink based on your team’s requirements.
  • Incorporate small industrial office designs for compact yet functional spaces.
2. Modular Furniture Solutions
  • Desks, partitions and storage units that can be reconfigured or expanded.
  • Ergonomic designs for comfort and productivity.
3. Open Space Designs
  • Create a modern open space office design for collaboration and better use of floor space.
  • Integrate office design ideas for businesses that focus on flexibility and efficiency.
4. Smart Space Utilization
  • Efficiently use every corner of your office with innovative office space design ideas tailored to your needs.

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Our Modular Design Process

1. Initial Consultation
We discuss your business goals, space challenges and requirements to understand your needs.

2. Layout Planning
Our team develops detailed plans that include modular office furniture designs and scalable layouts.

3. Visualization and Feedback
View 3D renders of your design, providing feedback to ensure it meets your expectations.

4. Implementation and Delivery
We execute the plan with precision, delivering a flexible and functional workspace within 45 days.

Who Benefits from Modular Office Designs?

Startups

Quickly scale up as your team grows with minimal disruptions.

Hybrid Work Models

Adapt your space for a mix of in-office and remote work setups.

Small Businesses

Optimize smaller spaces with creative small office workstations

Co-Working Spaces

Offer flexible configurations to suit tenant preferences and maximize occupancy.

Project
Featured Projects

Crafting Office Designs That Inspire Productivity

Advatix - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Blended functional design with cultural elements to foster collaboration, integrity and a dynamic work environment.

Wishlink - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Designed a vibrant and creative workspace with chillout zones, inspiring wall art and dynamic interiors that spark innovation and energy.

Explore more of our projects to see how we’ve transformed spaces for businesses like yours.

Discover more

FAQs About Modular Office Design

1. What is modular office design?

Modular office design involves scalable layouts and furniture that can be easily reconfigured to meet changing needs.

2. Is modular design suitable for small offices?

Yes. We offer modern office design ideas for small spaces that maximize functionality without compromising aesthetics.

3. How long does it take to implement a modular design?

We deliver fully functional modular office designs within 45 days.

Get Started with Modular Office Design in Gurgaon Today!

Looking for a flexible, scalable, and efficient office space? Our modular office design in Gurgaon solutions are tailored to meet your business's evolving needs.
Let’s create a future-proof workspace that enhances productivity, aesthetics, and brand identity.

Start Your Modular Office Journey Today

Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR – Revitalize Your Workspace

Orange Offices transforms outdated workspaces into modern, functional and inspiring environments for businesses across Delhi NCR.

Get In Touch About

Modern Office Renovation

Is your office outdated or lacking efficiency? At Orange Offices, we specialize in Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR, transforming workspaces into modern, functional, and high-performance environments tailored to today’s business needs.

Our Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR Services Include:

✔ Optimized Office Layouts – Smart space planning for improved workflow and aesthetics with Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR. 

✔ Upgraded Interiors – Enhanced flooring, lighting, and ergonomic furnishings under Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR. 

✔ Smart Office Technology – IoT and automation for increased efficiency with Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR. 

✔ Sustainable Enhancements – Eco-friendly upgrades for a greener, healthier workspace in Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR. 

✔ Efficient Project Management – Seamless execution of Corporate Office Renovation in Delhi NCR for minimal disruption.

🔹 Want to see our latest projects? Connect with us on social media:
📸 Instagram: Orange Offices
💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices
🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Read More Read Less
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Why Renovate Your Office?

Boost Productivity

A modern and well-designed office improves workflow and employee satisfaction.

Attract and Retain Talent

A fresh, inspiring workspace makes your business a desirable place to work.

Maximize Space Utilization

Update your layout to accommodate evolving team needs or hybrid work models.

Strengthen Brand Image

Impress clients and visitors with a sleek, professional office interior.

Features of Our Office Renovation Services

1. Layout Redesign
  • Optimize space for better functionality and collaboration.
  • Incorporate modern office interior design ideas for maximum efficiency.
2. Modern Aesthetic Updates
  • Refresh walls, flooring and furniture with contemporary designs and finishes.
  • Add features like office wall designs or bold reception areas to enhance visual appeal.
3. Technology Integration
  • Update wiring, networking and tech setups to meet modern business requirements.
4. Sustainable Upgrades
  • Incorporate energy-efficient lighting, HVAC systems and sustainable materials for eco-friendly renovations.

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Our Renovation Process

1. Assessment and Planning

2. Design Concept

item.title: Eco-Friendly Workspace Design
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
Green Office Design in Gurgaon Where Sustainability Meets Innovation

Orange Offices helps businesses across Delhi NCR create eco-friendly workspaces that prioritize sustainability, enhance well-being and inspire productivity.

DesignYour Eco-Friendly Workplace About

Eco-Friendly Workspace Design

Today’s businesses need workspaces that embrace sustainability without sacrificing aesthetics. At Orange Offices, we specialize in Green Office Design in Gurgaon, creating eco-friendly environments that enhance employee well-being and minimize environmental impact.

What Makes Our Green Offices Unique?

✔ LEED-Certified Design – Compliant with global green building standards for Green Office Design in Gurgaon.

 ✔ Biophilic Design Elements – Integrating nature to create a refreshing workspace with Green Office Design in Gurgaon. 

✔ Energy-Efficient Systems – Smart lighting and ventilation to reduce the carbon footprint in Green Office Design in Gurgaon. 

✔ Sustainable & Recyclable Materials – Healthier, eco-conscious office solutions under Green Office Design in Gurgaon. 

✔ Smart Office Solutions – Our Green Office Design in Gurgaon ensures a balance of functionality and sustainability.

🔹 Want to see our latest projects? Connect with us on social media:
📸 Instagram: Orange Offices
💼 LinkedIn: Orange Offices
🎥 YouTube: Orange Offices

Read More Read Less
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Why Choose an Eco-Friendly Workspace?

Lower Operational Costs

Energy-efficient lighting, HVAC systems and materials help reduce utility expenses.

Promote Employee Well-Being

Natural light, better air quality and biophilic elements enhance productivity and health.

Contribute to a Greener Future

Sustainable designs reduce carbon footprint and support eco-conscious practices.

Features of Our Eco-Friendly Designs

1. Energy Efficiency
  • LED lighting and smart controls.
  • Optimized HVAC systems for reduced energy consumption.
2. Sustainable Materials
  • Recycled and eco-friendly materials for flooring, walls and furniture.
  • Low-VOC paints and adhesives for better indoor air quality.
3. Biophilic Design
  • Incorporation of natural elements like plants, wood and stone to connect employees with nature.
  • Large windows for maximum natural light and reduced dependence on artificial lighting.
4. Space Optimization
  • Efficient office space design ideas that blend style with sustainability.

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Our Process for Eco-Friendly Designs

1. Sustainability Assessment
We evaluate your space to understand how it can be optimized for energy efficiency and sustainability.

2. Custom Green Solutions
Our designers develop a plan tailored to your business needs, including office wall designs and eco-conscious layouts.

3. Implementation
We source sustainable materials and install energy-efficient systems while managing every detail of the project.

4. Delivery
Your eco-friendly office is completed and delivered within 30 days, ready to support your team and the environment.

Who Benefits from Modular Office Designs?

Startups

Quickly scale up as your team grows with minimal disruptions.

Large Corporates

Align your CSR initiatives with impactful eco-friendly workspace designs.

Small Businesses

Optimize smaller spaces with creative small office workstations

Co-Working Spaces

Offer flexible configurations to suit tenant preferences and maximize occupancy.

Project
Featured Projects

Crafting Office Designs That Inspire Productivity

Indargo - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Designed an eco-friendly office for Indargo, using sustainable materials, modular furniture and natural accents to reflect their green vision.

Farmart - Coprorate Office in Gurgaon

Delivered a sleek modern office interior design with custom workstations and a welcoming reception area.

Explore more of our projects to see how we’ve transformed spaces for businesses like yours.

Discover more

FAQs About Eco-Friendly Workspace Design

1. What makes a workspace eco-friendly?

Eco-friendly workspaces use energy-efficient systems, sustainable materials and biophilic design elements to reduce their environmental impact.

2. Can eco-friendly designs be implemented in small offices?

Yes. We specialize in modern office design ideas for small spaces that are sustainable and functional.

3. How does an eco-friendly design benefit my business?

It lowers operational costs, improves employee well-being and positions your brand as socially responsible.

Looking for a green office that promotes well-being and efficiency? Connect with our experts today!

Transform your workspace into a dynamic environment that adapts to your business needs. Partner with Orange Offices to create a flexible modular office design that’s efficient, scalable and future-ready.

Start Your Modular Office Journey Today

Green Office Design in Gurgaon Where Sustainability Meets Innovation

[elementor-element k="30462b61238088190e6d3f7396b31c25" data=""]
DesignYour Eco-Friendly Workplace
About

Eco-Friendly Workspace Design

[elementor-element k="30462b61238088190e6d3f7396b31c25" data=""]
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Why Choose an Eco-Friendly Workspace?

Lower Operational Costs

Energy-efficient lighting, HVAC systems and materials help reduce utility expenses.

Promote Employee Well-Being

Natural light, better air quality and biophilic elements enhance productivity and health.

Contribute to a Greener Future

Sustainable designs reduce carbon footprint and support eco-conscious practices.

Features of Our Eco-Friendly Designs

1. Energy Efficiency
  • LED lighting and smart controls.
  • Optimized HVAC systems for reduced energy consumption.
2. Sustainable Materials
  • Recycled and eco-friendly materials for flooring, walls and furniture.
  • Low-VOC paints and adhesives for better indoor air quality.
3. Biophilic Design
  • Incorporation of natural elements like plants, wood and stone to connect employees with nature.
  • Large windows for maximum natural light and reduced dependence on artificial lighting.
4. Space Optimization
  • Efficient office space design ideas that blend style with sustainability.

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Our Process for Eco-Friendly Designs

[elementor-element k="30462b61238088190e6d3f7396b31c25" data=""]

Who Benefits from Modular Office Designs?

Startups

Quickly scale up as your team grows with minimal disruptions.

Large Corporates

Align your CSR initiatives with impactful eco-friendly workspace designs.

Small Businesses

Optimize smaller spaces with creative small office workstations

Co-Working Spaces

Offer flexible configurations to suit tenant preferences and maximize occupancy.

Project
Featured Projects

Crafting Office Designs That Inspire Productivity

Indargo - Corporate Office in Gurgaon

Designed an eco-friendly office for Indargo, using sustainable materials, modular furniture and natural accents to reflect their green vision.

Farmart - Coprorate Office in Gurgaon

Delivered a sleek modern office interior design with custom workstations and a welcoming reception area.
[elementor-element k="30462b61238088190e6d3f7396b31c25" data=""]
Discover more

FAQs About Eco-Friendly Workspace Design

1. What makes a workspace eco-friendly?

Eco-friendly workspaces use energy-efficient systems, sustainable materials and biophilic design elements to reduce their environmental impact.

2. Can eco-friendly designs be implemented in small offices?

Yes. We specialize in modern office design ideas for small spaces that are sustainable and functional.

3. How does an eco-friendly design benefit my business?

It lowers operational costs, improves employee well-being and positions your brand as socially responsible.

Looking for a green office that promotes well-being and efficiency? Connect with our experts today!

Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio – Explore Our Creative Excellence

Step into our Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio and discover stunning workspace transformations. At Orange Offices, we craft office interiors that seamlessly blend aesthetics, innovation, and functionality, creating inspiring work environments for businesses of all sizes.

Our Gallery

Where Every Space Tells a Story

We believe in design's power to connect and inspire. From architecture to art, our creations reflect the world around us. Here, we share the stories that fuel our creativity.

What You’ll Find in Our Portfolio:

✔ Corporate & Commercial Spaces – Professional, high-performance office interiors in Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio.

✔ Modern Office Designs – Stylish and practical workspaces featured in Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio.

✔ Sustainable Workspaces – Green-certified designs for an eco-conscious approach in Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio.

✔ Flexible & Modular Layouts – Adaptable office spaces designed for future growth showcased in Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio.

✔ Bespoke Interior Solutions – Each project in our Office Interior Design Gallery & Portfolio highlights precision and creativity.

Let’s Design the Office You’ve Always Dreamed Of

Whether you’re starting fresh or looking to revamp your workspace, Orange Offices is here to help. Contact us today to discuss your vision and transform your office into a space that inspires.

Contact Us Today

item.title: Design
item.dc:creator: roshan
item.content:encoded:
Transforming Workspaces, Empowering Businesses

Orange Offices is your trusted partner in designing and building custom office spaces that inspire creativity, foster collaboration and reflect your unique vision.

Get in Touch

Trusted By 600+ World-Class Brands And Organizations

Testimonials

What Clients Say About Us

At AIHP, excellence is standard. From top-tier offices to tailored designs, every aspect exceeds expectations. Choosing AIHP was simple - simply exceptional. SUDHIR SHARMARegional Head AIHP has been an invaluable partner in creating a prestigious workspace for Anand Rathi Wealth. Their professionalism, attention to detail and ability to understand our specific needs have contributed significantly to our success. MUKESH KUMAWATExecutive Director We go with the AIHP because it takes care of end to end managed services This means that we need we can easily focus on artwort rather than looking at the facilities. ASHISH CHAHDACEO & Co-Founder AIHP's attention to detail & quick delivery exceeded our expectations. In just three months, they brought our vision to life flawlessly. Their top-notch team and seamless design process made it one of our best office experiences. SAHIL CHALANAFounder
Why Choose Orange Offices?
Why US

Your Trusted Partner for Office Design

Crafted for Success

Tailor-made office interiors designed for productivity and style.

Eco-Friendly Innovation

Sustainable, eco-conscious solutions for modern workspaces.

Fast & Reliable Delivery

Delivered in just 45 days by our dedicated team.

Trusted Across Delhi NCR

Serving businesses across Delhi NCR with world-class design

Transform Your Workspace With Orange Offices

Get Started

Encouraging Transparency and Flexibility

https://youtu.be/SZg3GQYhwZY AIHP has been a reliable partner for the last seven years. During our time at Star Tower, they not only fulfilled our specific office requirements but also guided us with valuable improvements based on their expertise. Our decision to move to the 21st floor of IFC M3M was another great experience—AIHP created an incredible office environment that aligns perfectly with our wealth management services. The space consistently impresses our high-net-worth clients, showcasing what a premier wealth management outfit should look like. Mukesh Kumawat Executive Director at Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd.
Process
Benefit

Our Design Journey

1. Brief

We understand your needs, goals and vision to craft a workspace tailored to your business.

2. Concept

Creative ideas shape a functional, inspiring office, focusing on layout, flow and culture.

3. Visualisations

Detailed 3D renderings bring your ideas to life before construction begins.

4. Detail & Design

We align your design with the building’s structure, using sustainable materials and addressing lighting, utilities, and layout

5. Project Management

End-to-end management ensures smooth coordination and flawless execution.

6. 45-Day Delivery

Your workspace is designed and built within 45 days, ensuring quality and timeliness.

FAQs About Bespoke Office Design

1. How long does it take to complete a bespoke office design?

We deliver custom-designed offices within 30 days, ensuring minimal disruption to your operations.

2. Can you design offices for small spaces?

Absolutely. We specialize in modern office design ideas for small spaces that maximize utility and aesthetics.

3. What does bespoke office design include?

Our services include layout planning, furniture design, branding integration and complete project management.

Let’s Design the Office You’ve Always Dreamed Of

Whether you’re starting fresh or looking to revamp your workspace, Orange Offices is here to help. Contact us today to discuss your vision and transform your office into a space that inspires.

Contact Us Today

item.content:encoded:
Career

Office Interior Design Jobs in Gurgaon – Join Our Dynamic Team

Are you passionate about designing modern, inspiring workspaces? Orange Offices is looking for talented professionals to join our team and work on cutting-edge Office Interior Design Jobs in Gurgaon projects.

Why Work at Orange Offices?

A Great Work Environment

We believe that great work comes from happy employees. Here at Orange Offices, we grow a caring and stimulating culture of teamwork, communication, and creativity that drives results.

Endless Coffee & Refreshments

Great coffee is the source of many innovative ideas! Receive unlimited coffee, tea, and snacks to top up your levels all day long.

Competitive Salary & Benefits

Your dedication is worth the best of the best remuneration. We provide salaries that are at par with industry standards, performance-based bonuses, and career-strengthening benefits to support and retain our best performers.

Career Growth & Development

We care about your future. Orange Offices provides mentorship programs, professional development, and leadership positions to support your growth and progression in your profession.

Collaborative & Inclusive Culture

We honor diversity, collaboration, and innovation. Each member of our team is instrumental in creating our industry-leading solutions, and your voice will always be heard and respected.

Discover Our Job Opportunities

Are you ready to join Orange Offices mission to transform workspaces in Gurgaon? We seek enthusiastic professionals across different fields, including:

Discover your next career opportunity and apply now!
Operations & Facility Management Leasing & Business Development Marketing & Branding Design & Architecture Customer Support & Client Relations

[awsmjobs]

Didn't find a role that suits your skills? No worries! Share your resume with us at careers@orangeoffices.in, and we'll consider you for future positions.

Become a part of Orange Offices – Where Careers and Workspaces Evolve Together

If you're passionate about creating inspiring office spaces and want to be part of a company that values design excellence, Orange Offices is the place for you. We are always on the lookout for talented professionals who can contribute to our vision of revolutionizing office interiors.

Interested in Office Interior Design Jobs Gurgaon? Apply today and be part of our expert team!

📸 Follow us on Instagram: Orange Offices

💼 Connect with us on LinkedIn: Orange Offices

🎥 Watch our latest projects on YouTube: Orange Offices

We look forward to welcoming you to our team and shaping the future of office interiors together!

Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon

Get in touch with our expert team for Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon. Let’s Design Your Ideal Workspace

Let’s Connect and Bring Your Office Vision to Life

Planning to design or renovate your office? At Orange Offices, we offer expert Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon, helping businesses craft functional, stylish, and productivity-enhancing workspaces. A well-designed office not only enhances workflow efficiency but also reflects a company’s brand identity and culture. Our Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon ensures that every element of your office is optimized for comfort, collaboration, and growth.

What Our Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon Covers:

✔ Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon – Strategically optimized layouts for improved workflow and efficiency.
✔ Design Concept & Material Selection – Choosing the perfect aesthetics and high-quality finishes to align with your brand.
✔ Budget & Timeline Estimation – Ensuring cost-effective solutions with on-time project delivery for seamless execution.
✔ Smart Office Solutions & Technology – Integrating automation, AI-driven tools, and IoT-enabled features for a futuristic workplace.
✔ Sustainability & Eco-Friendly Planning – Reducing carbon footprint with green office strategies, including energy-efficient lighting and recycled materials.
✔ Space Planning & Optimization – Maximizing available space through intelligent layout designs that promote efficiency and flexibility.
✔ Employee-Centric Workspaces – Designing interiors that prioritize ergonomics, wellness, and collaboration to enhance productivity.
✔ Hybrid & Modular Workspaces – Providing scalable solutions to accommodate evolving business needs and remote work setups.
✔ Industry-Specific Office Design – Tailored consultation for IT, finance, healthcare, and creative industries to meet specific workspace requirements.
✔ Turnkey Office Solutions – From conceptualization to implementation, our Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon ensures a hassle-free transformation.

Our experienced office interior consultants guide you through every step, ensuring your office design aligns with your business goals, company culture, and operational needs. With Office Design Consultation in Gurgaon, we focus on creating work environments that inspire creativity, improve employee satisfaction, and enhance operational efficiency.

Trusted By Leading Global Brands

From startups to Fortune 500s, Orange Offices has powered workspaces for businesses that value design, efficiency, and reliability.

Client Success Stories

Discover firsthand accounts from our satisfied clients and understand why AIHP is the leader in providing managed workspace solutions in Gurgaon

Learn how our fully furnished office spaces in Gurgaon drive business success, offering leasing options that cater to diverse business needs.

From fully furnished office spaces to bespoke private offices, AIHP transforms corporate environments into thriving business hubs.

Our clients appreciate the seamless integration of services and strategic locations, enhancing their operational efficiency and workplace satisfaction in Gurgaon’s prime office locations.

At AIHP, excellence is standard. From top-tier offices to tailored designs, every aspect exceeds expectations. Choosing AIHP was simple - simply exceptional. SUDHIR SHARMARegional Head AIHP has been an invaluable partner in creating a prestigious workspace for Anand Rathi Wealth. Their professionalism, attention to detail and ability to understand our specific needs have contributed significantly to our success. MUKESH KUMAWATExecutive Director We go with the AIHP because it takes care of end to end managed services This means that we need we can easily focus on artwort rather than looking at the facilities. ASHISH CHAHDACEO & Co-Founder AIHP's attention to detail & quick delivery exceeded our expectations. In just three months, they brought our vision to life flawlessly. Their top-notch team and seamless design process made it one of our best office experiences. SAHIL CHALANAFounder

Empowering Success, One Client at a Time

Let’s Bring Your Dream Office to Life

Ready to transform your workspace? Partner with Orange Offices for a tailor-made office interior design experience that prioritizes your vision and business goals.

Contact Our Design Team Today

item.title: INDAGRO
item.dc:creator: Saarthak
item.content:encoded:
Project info

Client
Indagro
Project Year
2024
Location
AIHP Milestone
Seats
50

Indagro: Crafting a Global Hub Through Office Design

Indagro, a global leader in fertilizer trading, collaborated with Orange Offices to create a state-of-the-art workspace at AIHP Milestone, Gurgaon. Designed to support their dynamic and interconnected operations, the office embodies a unified environment for their expanding team. The design features flexible work areas, advanced meeting spaces and optimized layouts tailored to the needs of a global business. By fostering connectivity and reflecting Indagro’s innovative spirit, the office serves as a hub for worldwide operations, seamlessly blending functionality with a professional and modern aesthetic.

Strategic Space Planning

Our design approach for Indagro’s office focused on sustainability and efficiency, reusing much of the existing fit-out to reduce waste and lower the project’s carbon footprint. The layout was meticulously planned to create a seamless flow of movement and connectivity throughout the space. A new main reception area welcomes visitors, while the second-floor assistant reception was repurposed exclusively for staff. A central spine was introduced to open up the middle of the floorplate, providing clear sight lines and emphasizing the scale of the space. With 50 strategically placed seats, the workspace is optimized for collaboration, functionality and future growth.

Minimal Waste, Maximum Impact

Indagro’s office redesign focuses on efficiency and functionality, utilizing existing fit-out elements to reduce waste and minimize environmental impact. The layout features a central spine for seamless movement and clear sight lines, complemented by a thoughtfully designed pantry area that fosters team connection and collaboration

item.title: CORDELIA CRUISES
item.dc:creator: Saarthak
item.content:encoded:
Project info

Client
Cordelia Cruises
Project Year
2024
Location
AIHP Skyline
Seats
115

Cordelia Cruises: Elevating Luxury Through Office Design

Cordelia Cruises, synonymous with premium Indian cruising experiences, partnered with Orange Offices to create a workspace at AIHP Skyline, Gurgaon, that reflects their luxurious brand identity. The design concept captures the essence of Indian hospitality, blending it with modern aesthetics to align with their dedication to delivering world-class experiences. The office seamlessly combines sophistication and functionality, offering an inspiring environment for their dynamic team. With a focus on creativity and collaboration, the workspace embodies Cordelia Cruises’ commitment to excellence and innovation in the cruising industry.

Elevating Luxury: Inside Cordelia Cruises’ Elegantly Crafted Office

Every detail of the Cordelia Cruises office was thoughtfully designed to reflect the brand’s luxurious and stylish identity. From handpicked materials to bespoke finishes, the design balances elegance with functionality. Incorporating rich textures and refined details, the space was meticulously crafted to create a premium working environment. The 115-seat office seamlessly supports operations, while precise execution and close collaboration ensured a smooth project delivery aligned with Cordelia Cruises' vision.

Transformed

With innovative design, we reimagined Cordelia Cruises’ workspace into a vibrant and luxurious hub that reflects their premium brand identity. The open-plan office includes stylish workstations, a welcoming pantry space and thoughtfully designed collaborative zones. Nautical-inspired accents and bespoke finishes bring the essence of cruising into the office, while the design ensures functionality meets elegance. The workspace is a testament to Cordelia's vision of offering uniquely Indian, world-class experiences, now seamlessly extending to their operational environment.

HT Media: Bridging Legacy and Future Through Office Design

HT Media, a cornerstone of Indian journalism since 1924, collaborated with Orange Offices to craft a workspace at AIHP Horizon, Gurgaon, that reflects its rich legacy and forward-thinking vision. As a trusted voice shaping culture and public opinion, the new office embodies the evolution of Indian media. The design seamlessly integrates elements of HT Media’s storied past with cutting-edge features that embrace the future of journalism. With spaces promoting collaboration, creativity and technological innovation, the office captures the essence of a dynamic nation and HT Media’s role in shaping its aspirations.

Consult and Design

To align with HT Media’s forward-thinking vision, we engaged in a collaborative process to understand their needs deeply. Through comprehensive employee surveys and workshops with key stakeholders, we gained insights into their technological and spatial requirements. The result is a thoughtfully designed space that fosters creativity, innovation and collaboration, perfectly attuned to HT Media’s pivotal role in India's evolving narrative.

Manage and Build

Our brief was to design a vibrant and collaborative workspace across 21,153 sq ft that reflects HT Media’s innovative ethos. The previous setup lacked energy and cohesion, prompting us to reimagine their office environment into a dynamic and inspiring space. By incorporating HT Media’s brand colors throughout, we created a cohesive and engaging design. Meeting rooms were infused with bold colors and flexible breakout areas were outfitted with versatile furniture to encourage interaction and creativity. The result is a lively, community-focused hub that embodies HT Media’s forward-looking vision and supports collaboration at every turn.

item.dc:creator: Saarthak
item.content:encoded:
Project info

Client
Indxx
Project Year
2024
Location
AIHP Skyline
Estimate Budget
$200,000.-

Indxx: Defining Global Leadership Through Office Design

Indxx, a global leader in indexing, partnered with Orange Offices to create a workspace at AIHP Skyline, Gurgaon, that reflects its independent identity and innovative spirit. Moving from a shared corporate setting, the new office establishes a distinctive presence, showcasing their expertise in the indexing industry. The thoughtfully designed space combines modern sophistication with functionality, incorporating Indxx’s brand colors and state-of-the-art features. It fosters collaboration, supports technological excellence and aligns perfectly with Indxx’s forward-thinking ethos, setting the stage for continued growth and leadership in the global indexing arena.

Crafting a Best-in-Class Environment

The mission was to create a world-class workspace that seamlessly reflected Indxx's brand identity and culture. With a design approach rooted in hospitality, the space was envisioned to warmly welcome clients while exuding innovation and quality. The result is a sophisticated yet approachable environment that supports collaboration, embodies excellence and aligns with Indxx’s standing as a global indexing leader.

Client-Centric Design

Indxx's new workspace is tailored to create a welcoming and refined atmosphere for client interactions, showcasing professionalism and quality. A striking illuminated fluted column serves as a focal point upon entry, guiding visitors to a premium teapoint designed for both daytime and evening client engagements. Adjacent to this is a versatile boardroom with folding doors, allowing seamless transitions from formal meetings to sophisticated social events, entertainment, or conferences—enhancing both functionality and experience. This new workplace offers Indxx a distinct sense of identity and independence, seamlessly blending sophistication with functionality. The design captures the essence of their brand, creating a dynamic, client-focused environment that reflects their global presence and innovative spirit.
